selected_records.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement

article.body:
ArXiv listing names work on stateful code for robot self-improvement

An arXiv record lists “Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement.” The supplied material includes no paper text or findings, so it establishes no robot embodiment, manipulation task, training data, autonomy level or physical test. It does not show that a robot demonstrated any capability outside a lab.
